name: 20 cal assault bike, one bout (before the evening class workout)
notes: Free Workout recording of one bout, 30 min before the class workout (separate recording, not labelled here).

Sync test: the athlete clapped once before the first stroke and 3 times after the last: 10-13 g spikes at 4.09 s and 99.70 / 101.03 / 102.38 s (pedalling stays under 1.6 g). Crown turned at 109.1 s, about 10 s after the last stroke.

Bike segment from motion, bracketed by the claps: first effort 4.30 s, last arm cycle 99.30 s, effort ends 99.50 s. 98 arm cycles (forearm angle, one per revolution), 61.7 rpm mean, 61-64 in every 20 s.

Console values from the athlete (ErgZone summary screen), independent of the motion: see the segment's console block. Per-second data not available: the console's 91.4 s cannot be placed exactly inside the 95.2 s of motion.

Watch vs console: time 95.2 s of motion (first to last arm cycle 94.3 s) vs 91.4 s; cadence 61.7 vs 61 rpm; 94 arm cycles in any 91.4 s window vs 92.9 revolutions implied by 61 rpm x 91.4 s. The watch has no calorie or distance estimate for a bike; its pedometer reads 2.8 steps.
1631 cal/h is not the bout's average (20 cal in 91.4 s = 788 cal/h): probably the reading at the end or the peak (not stated).
